A personal tour of my first ever gallery art show and how it went. Brought to us by Squarespace. Go to http://squarespace.com/makesomething to save 10% oﬀ your first purchase of a website or domain using code MAKESOMETHING.

Pre-order the book here: https://makesomething.com/product/p/unsubscribe-book

In this video, I give a personal tour through my first ever art show, featuring mixed media sculptures, wall hangings, and original art made from wood, metal, and found objects over the past nine years. I walk through every piece in the gallery, talk about pricing art, what sold, and what didn't, and share what's changing with this YouTube channel going forward.
